input.question: Broad topic: history of India. Please recommend a comprehensive book that covers it from ancient times to 20th century.
input.ground_truth: Hate to harp on what you've already acknowledged, but South Asia is a very large, culturally/linguistically diverse area that is one of the earliest sites of civilization. Any one book you read is going to leave out a whole lot. It might be better to pick a particular region or time period or cultural phenomena/group that interests you, and then look for a book from there. That said, these are the three that I would recommend: 1) Early India, from Origins to AD 1300 (Romila Thapar) 2) India Before Europe (Catherine Asher & Cynthia Talbot) 3) A Concise History of Modern India (Metcalfe & Metcalfe)

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Broad topic: history of India. Please recommend a comprehensive book that covers it from ancient times to 20th century.

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you want to learn about all the stories and adventures that happened in India, from a very, very long time ago until about 100 years ago. That’s like reading a big storybook about India’s life.

A good big book for that is called **"A History of India" by John Keay**. But it’s a little long for a 5-year-old. For a grown-up or someone who likes to read big books, this one tells lots and lots of stories about Indian kings, queens, wars, and changes, starting from when people first came to India, all the way up to the time when India became its own country.

If you want a simpler book for a 5-year-old, you might like **"India: A Peek Inside" by Gail Saltzberg** or **"The Story of India" by Valmik Thapar (for children)**. These books have pretty pictures and easy words to tell the big story of India in a way that’s fun to read.

So, if you want all the big stories, try the John Keay book when you’re older. If you want it now, try the picture books!
